description:
Play Gruul Turf.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces token's trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Gruul Turf trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
